tonight.headline: Down 64.8 with Allen and Jefferson to come — an 8% chance
body: Bad news first: the Sunday games are all final and they went against you. Allgeier had every Arizona back carry and still made only 6.6 in a blowout at Seattle, Gordon 7.4, Diggs 8.1 on 5 targets, Tuten 8.9. Talla Metralla are done at 141.12 — Burrow 29.5 and Golden 32.4 — against your 76.3.

Allen and Jefferson play tonight at 19:15 CDMX and need 64.8 between them (ESPN projects 38.6). Both are already in the lineup, there is nothing to set, and ESPN gives you 8%. The next decision is Tuesday's claim run.

case.label: The script that wins it
case.body: Allen 40-plus and Jefferson 25-plus in the same game. Allen faces Minnesota, 1st vs QB by the carried grades; Jefferson faces Buffalo, 28th vs WR. Talla Metralla have no one left to play.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allen and Jefferson combine for 64.8 or more — then AVIATO win and the 8% read was too pessimistic.
